# NVIDIA

> > NVIDIA is the global leader in AI computing, graphics processing, and accelerated computing technologies, powering everything from gaming to data centers.

NVIDIA develops GPUs, AI platforms, and cloud gaming services including GeForce graphics cards, GeForce NOW streaming, and enterprise AI solutions like Nemotron. The company partners with major technology firms to advance AI infrastructure and personal computing innovation.

## Key Topics

- GeForce RTX graphics cards
- GeForce NOW cloud gaming
- Ray tracing and DLSS technology
- NVIDIA AI and Agentic AI solutions
- Jensen Huang (CEO)
- NVIDIA Reflex
- NVIDIA Studio
- RTX 40 and 50 series GPUs
- AI infrastructure and data centers
- NVLink integration
- PC Game Pass integration
- Steam platform support
- Ultimate membership tier
- Custom CPU design partnerships

## AI and Enterprise Solutions

- [Agentic AI Solutions | Transform Your Business With NVIDIA Agentic AI](https://ai.nvidia.com/): NVIDIA Agentic AI solutions using Nemotron and RAG for enterprise automation
- [NVIDIA and Intel to Develop AI Infrastructure and Personal Computing Products | NVIDIA Newsroom](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-and-intel-to-develop-ai-infrastructure-and-personal-computing-products): NVIDIA-Intel partnership for AI infrastructure and custom data center products
